description: Na₄Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.48 Å) and two longer (2.63 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal bipyramidal geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.49 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.18 Å) and two longer (2.24 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.48 Å. Mg is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.93 Å) and two longer (1.96 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.71 Å) and two longer (1.81 Å) Co-O bond lengths. In the second Co site, Co is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.77 Å) and one longer (1.79 Å) Co-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Co atom.
